testcase.name: Scenario: Hide, restore and reorder a recent-document column: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-home-recent-documents-source/features/application/home-recent-documents/home-recent-documents.feature:144:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Hide, restore and reorder a recent-document column ✔ Given the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native` ✔ And the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And recent documents are in List View ✔ And Location is displayed immediately after Name ✔ When the user opens Column Settings and clears Location ✔ Then the Location header and values disappear from the list ✔ And Location is unchecked in Available Columns ✔ When the user selects Location again ✔ Then Location appears after the other adjustable columns ✔ When the user drags Location above Date Modified in Displayed Columns ✔ Then Location appears immediately after Name in the list
